player_prompt.intro:
Tettekkaɣeɣ Blackjack ɣer aneggar.
Takkayt inek d akken ad tɛeggel ɣer 21 anɣas ur tetteɣɣeɣ.
Deg tesrit, sɛeɣ '[Hit]' ad tɛawdeɣ aɣerwal udis neɣ '[Stand]' ad tesɛeɣ.
J/Q/K = 10 n yifɛan ; A = 11 neɣ 1, anect-a yettɛawdeɣ ɣurk.
